summary: Harmony Gold Mining Company Limited filed a Form 6-K on August 21, 2026, providing a trading statement and operational update for the fiscal year ended June 30, 2026. The filing reports expected higher basic earnings versus the prior year, citing increased gold revenue and copper contributions from the recently acquired CSA mine. It discusses operational metrics, impairment reversals, and cost factors. No transaction, tender offer, activist, restructuring, or other special-situation event is announced. This is a routine earnings guidance update under Rule 13a-16, thus not a special situation. What to watch: upcoming full financial results and continued integration of MAC Copper.
